# 8bar Systems

> 8bar Systems is a software studio based in Central, Hong Kong, serving startups and scaleups worldwide. We build mobile applications, backend APIs, and the platforms behind them — and we advise the engineering teams who run them. Our work is built on a decade of shipped systems in fintech, payments, trading, and high-throughput mobile. Tagline: "Engineered outcomes."

## What we do

8bar operates in two modes that share the same standards:

- **Build** — We design and ship software end-to-end: native mobile (iOS and Android), web frontends, backend APIs, databases, and the deployment infrastructure around them. Typical build engagements run 3 to 12 weeks. Examples: MVP product builds; event-driven backend services (Kafka, Postgres, Redis; JVM or Go); platform & CI/CD foundations (Kubernetes, Terraform, Argo CD, observability from day one); mobile applications.
- **Advise** — We work alongside existing engineering teams: architecture and codebase reviews (written reports with findings, risks, and prioritised remediations); cloud & platform audits (AWS or Azure — cost, reliability, security posture); incident response & SRE setup (on-call rotations, runbooks, observability stacks); and fractional CTO arrangements. Advisory engagements run from a single day.

The four kinds of work, in plain terms: **Build it** (new services, APIs, platforms for financial-grade workloads), **Run it** (cloud platforms, CI/CD, observability, on-call), **Rescue it** (stabilise and re-platform inherited systems), and **Architecture & advisory** (reviews, decision documents, second opinions).

## How we work

- Every engagement is scoped in writing before any code is written — the shape of the problem, the artifacts you'll get, and the timeline.
- Deliverables you can refer back to: architecture documents, audit reports, runbooks.
- Production-grade defaults: tests, observability, and CI from day one.
- Direct access to the engineer making the decisions — no account layer, no offshore handoff.
- We do not do open-ended staff augmentation, body-shop placements, or prototypes dressed up as production systems.

## Areas of expertise

- **Payments & FX** — multi-currency accounts, payment-processor integrations, settlement, reconciliation.
- **Trading & market infrastructure** — order flow, RFQ negotiation, settlement engines, real-time risk and position management.
- **High-throughput mobile platforms** — backend infrastructure for consumer apps at hundreds of thousands of requests per minute.
- **Event-driven architectures** — Kafka-based systems for real-time data flow within and across organisations.
- **Cloud platforms & migrations** — Kubernetes on AWS and Azure; gateway, ingress, and identity migrations on live systems.
- **Observability & SRE** — Prometheus/Grafana, alerting, on-call design, incident response and post-mortems.

## Technology

- Platform & SRE: Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Istio, Linkerd, Kong, workload identity
- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Loki, ELK, Alertmanager, PagerDuty
- Backend: Java, Kotlin, Go, Spring Boot, Micronaut, Akka, Kafka Streams
- Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, IAM, IRSA, CloudFront), Azure (AKS, Cosmos DB, Front Door)
- Data & messaging: Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, OpenSearch
